notes: Review paper: OBS nodes keep the source study's provenance and carry attrs.reproduced_from with the reference number printed in the caption. Branches: (A) boron covalently linked to the matrix (synthesis -> crosslinked gel -> fixed BO4- -> t+ -> uniform plating); (B) boron added as a salt or plasticizer that builds the interphase in situ (F9, F10). Control comparisons stay inside the OBS labels (LE-Celgard, e-Celgard, Gen2, PEO-LiTFSI, PA-Li, bare Li) rather than as a separate branch. F11a-c are attached to the DSC/comparison node rather than to an OBS node: the radar scores are the review authors' own unitless ratings, not a readout of an instrument, so no attrs.technique would be honest. Packet defects: (1) figure ids are offset from paper figure numbers from F9 on - packet F9 carries the 'Figure 10' caption, F10 'Figure 11', F11 'Figure 12', and paper Figure 9 (the lithium borate salt structures, cited as 'Figure 9a-c' in the F9 linked text) is absent from the record; (2) the F7 caption and the F7 linked text swap panels b and c (audit node o9); (3) in the F2 image panel (i) is the B-O-Si siloxane network and (j) the malonatoborate network, the opposite of the assignment in the F5 linked text; (4) the F10c crop contains panels c and d together, which is why its cue class is 'electrochemistry' although its caption span is a schematic; (5) the F10d crop's OCR letter reads 'a' and is flagged as disagreeing, but its tokens and content are panel d; (6) the F7 caption gives the current density as 0.2 mA cm-1; the panel prints mA cm-2; (7) the F9 linked text attributes Figure 10d to reference 104 while the caption and panel legend put it with the DSM-SPE work of reference 105, and panel g is never mentioned in the linked text; (8) the F10 linked text quotes 146 mAh/g initial at 140 C/3C where the panel plots ~170.

pairs.cause: incorporation of boron moieties by chemical reaction, in situ and ex situ polymerisation
pairs.effect: polymer matrices with sp3/sp2 boron centres, cross-linked networks and porous frameworks
pairs.note: three produces edges carry it: n6->n9 (backbone borate centres), n7->n10 (3D crosslinked network), n8->n11/n25 (in-situ interphases). The porous-framework (ANP-5) structure is not a node; it survives only inside o4's image_note.

pairs.cause: sp3/sp2 boron centres and cross-linked or branched architectures
pairs.effect: improved ionic conductivity, high Li+ transference number and enhanced mechanical strength
pairs.note: the transference-number half is supported (n9->n12/n13->n14, k2). The conductivity half is contradicted: n18 states an ionic-conductivity penalty for fixing the anion, n15 puts solid single-ion conductors at the bottom of the range, and n22's image_note records the conventional dual-ion reference as the outermost trace on ionic conductivity in F11a. Mechanical strength is not a node.

pairs.cause: high ionic conductivity, elevated Li+ transference number and robust mechanical properties
pairs.effect: enhanced safety, cycle life and rate capability
pairs.note: n14 -> n16 -> n17 with n10 and n11 also causing n17, evidenced by five cycling OBS nodes. The graph routes the performance gain through the transference number and the interphases, not through conductivity, and has no mechanical-property node.

pairs.cause: incorporation of boron by chemical modification or additive blending
pairs.effect: improved safety, thermal stability and electrochemical performance
pairs.note: the additive route reaches electrochemical performance through n5 -> n8 -> n11/n25 -> n16 -> n17. The thermal half is present as n20 -> n21 with o13 (F10a TG) and o14 (F10b), but n20 has no incoming processing edge, and the graph reads the TG result as unchanged stability (the 1:1:5 and 1:1:0 curves coincide) rather than as the improvement over carbonate liquids that the record claims.
